sentences.text: Sam y Luis están en la escuela.
sentences.english: Sam and Luis are at the school.
Today they talk about Honduras.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Luis, what is it like here?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it hot all the time?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: No, Sam.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Aquí hay verano y hay invierno.
sentences.english: Here there is a summer and there is a winter.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How many months does the summer have?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Six months.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: El invierno también tiene seis meses.
sentences.english: The winter also has six months.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: En verano hace sol y hace calor.
sentences.english: In summer it is sunny and hot.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It rains little.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And is it windy?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Sí, hace un poco de viento.
sentences.english: Yes, it is a little windy.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: At night it is cold.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And in winter, does it rain a lot?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Yes, there is a lot of rain.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Hay menos sol y hace menos calor.
sentences.english: There is less sun and it is less hot.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Hay mucho viento, y en la noche hace más frío.
sentences.english: There is a lot of wind, and at night it is colder.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What is better for you?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Para mí, la lluvia es mejor.
sentences.english: For me, the rain is better.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Hay menos gente en la calle.
sentences.english: There are fewer people in the street.

sentences.text: Mucha gente de Honduras trabaja con el café, el frijol, el arroz y el plátano.
sentences.english: Many people in Honduras work with coffee, beans, rice and plantains.
These people always need water.

sentences.text: El agua es una ayuda grande para la familia.
sentences.english: Water is a big help for the family.

sentences.text: Con agua hay mucho frijol, y el precio es barato.
sentences.english: With water there is a lot of beans, and the price is cheap.

sentences.text: No hay agua, el frijol es caro y la gente no compra mucho.
sentences.english: There is no water, the beans are expensive and people do not buy much.
Doña Marta is a Christian.

sentences.text: Ella cree en Dios y ora siempre.
sentences.english: She believes in God and always prays.

sentences.text: El pastor ora por el agua en la reunión de la iglesia.
sentences.english: The pastor prays for water at the church meeting.

sentences.text: Doña Marta tiene paz en el corazón porque Dios ayuda a su familia.
sentences.english: Doña Marta has peace in her heart because God helps her family.

sentences.text: Doña Marta vende pan en el mercado.
sentences.english: Doña Marta sells bread at the market.
Sam is with her today.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Doña Marta, ¿usted trabaja todos los días?
sentences.english: Doña Marta, do you work every day?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: No, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I work six days.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El domingo voy a la iglesia con mi familia.
sentences.english: On Sunday I go to church with my family.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: How much does the bread cost?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: A loaf costs five lempiras.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: The price is good.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Do people buy a lot of bread?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Sí, la gente siempre compra pan, plátano y frijol.
sentences.english: Yes, people always buy bread, plantain and beans.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Can I help, doña Marta?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, Sam.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tomá el dinero y pagá aquí.
sentences.english: Take the money and pay here.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Thanks.

sentences.text: Luis y Sam salen de la escuela.
sentences.english: Luis and Sam leave the school.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Sam, ¿podés venir a la reunión del equipo?
sentences.english: Sam, can you come to the team meeting?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Yes, I can.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Is it Saturday?

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Tenés que enviar un mensaje al pastor.
sentences.english: You have to send a message to the pastor.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Te doy su número de teléfono.
sentences.english: I will give you his phone number.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: It is new.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Thanks, Luis.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Right now I write down the number.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: You are welcome, Sam.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Tomorrow we talk more.

sentences.text: Sam escribe un mensaje a su familia.
sentences.english: Sam writes a message to his family.

sentences.text: La fecha de hoy es buena.
sentences.english: Today's date is a good one.
Sam is happy.
Hello, family.

sentences.text: Aquí hace sol, pero en la noche hace frío y hay lluvia.
sentences.english: Here it is sunny, but at night it is cold and there is rain.

sentences.text: Tengo un cuarto pequeño en la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: I have a small room in doña Marta's house.

sentences.text: Tengo poco dinero, pero estoy bien.
sentences.english: I have little money, but I am fine.
My life here is new.

sentences.text: Amo a la gente de aquí.
sentences.english: I love the people here.
Doña Marta cooks very well.

sentences.text: Todos los días comemos frijoles, arroz y pan.
sentences.english: Every day we eat beans, rice and bread.
Thanks for everything.
Sam
